title: Unit Event — Light Up the Fire — Episode5 We'll Be The Greatest!

meta.Event Outline: Vivid BAD SQUAD's explosive third event has roused expectations that the team might actually surpass RAD WEEKEND. That's when Taiga summons them for "an important conversation"...

rows.Line: Twenty years earlier
Vivid Street

rows.Speaker: Locals
rows.Line: Y-You quit your agency?!

rows.Speaker: Locals
rows.Line:
Why?!
You guys were so popular! That seems like a total waste!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Popularity? That has nothing to do with our dream! We wanna become the best musicians in the world!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: I don't care how big those snobs' agency is. I'm not letting them walk all over us just because they agreed to have us on some TV show.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Appearing on TV did have its benefits since it gave our songs more exposure. But we didn't set out to become on-air personalities.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
I mean, seriously.
They just kept going on and on about going on variety shows and appearing in these dumb romance movies. They even had the nerve to start trying to meddle with our songs.

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line: Hahaha. I did warn you that the way most people become famous nowadays wouldn't really be for you.

rows.Speaker: Owner of COL
rows.Line: But I do understand how someone would want a handsome guy like Ken to appear in a movie for them.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: I was hoping we could stay since we owed that agency quite a bit... But we reached the final straw. We just couldn't let them encroach any further.

rows.Speaker: Locals
rows.Line: So, what are you guys gonna do now...?

rows.Speaker: Owner of COL
rows.Line: Good question. Ken's got a college degree. You on the other hand, Taiga... You didn't even finish high school. Do you have a plan moving forward?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Yeah, of course.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: We're gonna start our own label.

rows.Speaker: Locals
rows.Line: Your own label?!

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: That's right! We had a long discussion, and we decided to start our own label here while continuing to perform!

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: In other words, it's back to square one for us!

rows.Speaker: Owner of COL
rows.Line:
Hah hah hah!
Talk about doing things the hard way!

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line:
As hard as it sounds...
It sounds like the right option for your team...

rows.Speaker: Locals
rows.Line: Then, Nagi, Ken, Taiga, we'll be rooting for you guys! My wife and son are also huge fans!

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
Haha!
Wait, your son only just learned to walk, didn't he? Won't we be bad influences on him?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Nah, it's all a part of getting a rounded education.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Hey, we have our own problems to deal with right now. We don't have time to be thinking about other people's families...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: We need to see if it's actually going to be possible for our label to even survive, and a whole list of other things to consider.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Yes, we know. Which is why you get to handle all of that, Ken! I mean, you're just so much better at those things than we are.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Nagi...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Hehe. We'll be counting on you, Ken!

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Anyway, we're still going to become the best musicians in the world!
A few years later
Yokohama

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Tours with back-to-back shows are always so exhausting...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: We were in Miyagi yesterday, Kanagawa today and we need to be in Osaka tomorrow by noon. Still, this is for the sake of our label. We have to keep going.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Taiga, instead of preaching, mind taking the wheel from here...?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
You want me to drive? Fine.
But you're getting one between the eyes if you fall asleep.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Be careful what you say, big guy.
Remember who's been driving us until now?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Alright, I get it...!
Also, Nagi, wake up! That's enough beauty sleep!

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
...
Huh?! What?!

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Wait, Taiga, you're not seriously driving next, are you?! Ken, can you please keep driving? He always gets really grumpy whenever anyone else falls asleep!

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Look, I could really use a break now...
Also, we should all be able to stay awake as long as we keep talking like this.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: This is why we should've hired a driver. Then, we could've all slept as much as we wanted.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: That costs money, which we don't have right now. Don't forget that we're not signed to a big label anymore.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Still, I can't believe how much of a toll this is taking on us. I feel like we could do a lot more when we were younger...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Like when we were still in school and sang for hours at COL after school?

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
We were so young back then.
All we did was sing! It'd be Friday night one second, then we were rushing to school in a panic on Monday the next! Those were the days.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
Oh, also!
Because of that, I remember all your fans being jealous of me since the three of us always came to school together, Ken!

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Wait, really?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Here we go, acting cool again. You've been doing that for as long as I can remember.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: But now, you're married to a charming, pretty woman like Yuka. You really don't know what life has in store for you, huh?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Haha. I thought you went to school to study, not chase after girls, college boy.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Hey, cut me some slack. It was love at first sight.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Anyway, we don't have time for this right now. If we don't make it to Osaka today, we'll have to sleep in the car.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
What...?!
Taiga, drive! Now!
A few years later
Vivid Street

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Wow, her hands and feet are so soft and adorably tiny! Seriously, Ken, your daughter's too beautiful!

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
I mean, look at her eyes!
They're just like Yuka's!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Yeah, you're right.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Have you already picked a name?

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Yeah.
She's An. An Shiraishi.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
Really?! An! An!
Yeah, it's perfect for her!

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: She's going to be a good kid! I know it! She'll be the nicest person everyone knows!

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Do you think she'll ever want to pursue music, like us?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Who knows?
But she sounds like she has a lot of energy.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: She does.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
Oh, also!
About what we'll be doing as a team moving forward...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: I was thinking that we could stop doing shows for a while in order to focus on mixing and recording.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Mixing?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Yeah, Nagi and I discussed it the other day.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Knowing you, Ken, we guessed that you'd wanna spend as much time as you can with An.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: You guys...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: We obviously need to keep expanding the label. Fortunately, we're sort of on our feet now...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: A lot of people have been downloading our tracks online! We've even been receiving offers from abroad from people saying that they want to use them.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Since we've managed to catch a nice tailwind, we thought it'd be good to focus more on mixing our songs and stuff instead!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: We were planning on doing this eventually anyway, but this opportunity sort of just fell in our lap...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: So, for now, be with your wife and daughter. You'd rather hang out with your daddy, right, An?
se_event_fire_2023_004

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Hey, my ugly mug isn't making her cry.
She might just have what it takes to become a star.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
Will you stop...?
Still, I agree with Taiga. You should spend as much time as you can with An.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: I mean, you don't want this cutie getting tired of you, right? Keep in mind that she won't care how handsome or dashing her daddy is.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: You guys...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Alright, I will.
Thanks...
Ten years later

rows.Speaker: Junior High School An
rows.Line:
Alright then, Dad, I'm gonna go home now!
Bye bye, Uncle Taiga!

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Alright, I'll see you later.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: I know you're excited about lunch, but don't trip and fall on your way over, okay?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School An
rows.Line: Hey, I'm not a kid anymore, so don't tease me like that! Anyway, bye!

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Anyway, let's get down to business...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Our US tour is this close to becoming a reality. Our sponsors sound pretty optimistic about it, so I'm looking forward to hearing some good news soon.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Taiga, have you already booked some flights for us? The executives of Burner Records apparently want us to meet them in person.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Yeah, they're booked.
But...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: The problem is Nagi...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
I know...
I never imagined her collapsing from anemia again.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: She hasn't been well for a while now... Is everything really okay with her?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: I don't know... She said it was just a cold, but maybe we should take another trip to the hospital.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Yeah, I'll join you.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: We have a few CDs releasing soon, so it'll be nice to discuss the plan for our tour next year in more detail.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Hey, Nagi.
You never call me. How's it—

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: What?
Hospital
se_event_fire_2023_001
se_event_fire_2023_001

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Nagi!

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
Taiga, Ken...
Sorry, but thanks for coming...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: We had to. I mean, what are you doing at the hospital? What happened? Is it anemia again?

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: So, um...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Just...try to stay calm and listen.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: I...have pancreatic cancer.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
And it's apparently pretty bad.
The doctor said I have maybe five months to live...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Five months...?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
No, wait. You're kidding, right?
I thought they always told the patient's family these things first.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: I asked them to tell me the results first because I know you're both incredibly busy right now...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: So, you really only have...?

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
Yeah...
They said I'll be able to walk around and stuff for a little while longer.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: But no amount of chemotherapy is apparently going to help.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: I'm sorry. We'd finally made it... The deal with Burner Records, the US tour...and now this happens.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: I'm really...sorry.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: But I guess we won't be able to rule the world together.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: That's not...the point...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Let's all just take a deep breath...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: I mean... I'm still having trouble processing what I just heard...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Same...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
Haha... I know...
I'm the one who's sick, but even my mind still can't seem to come to grips with it.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Still, I think I'm doing better than you two...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: When I called Mom and everyone earlier, she yelled at me for giving her such terrible news after not calling in forever. She was so distraught that I had to be the one to stay calm and get her to settle down.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Oh... Right...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: So, about us... About the future of RADder...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: You two should decide what happens moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: I mean, I'll be gone in less than six months, so I don't really have a say anymore...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: I'm going to think about what I'd like to do before I go...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Maybe we should all take some time to each think about what to do moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: (Nagi's...terminal...)

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: (Nagi...won't be here anymore...)

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
(No good...
It's not hitting me...)

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
...!
Burner Records just sent us an email...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
(Now...?!
I'm still processing what I just heard.)

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Taiga...
It's from Burner, but I'm putting them on hold for—

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Ken...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Sorry, but I don't think I can talk about any of that right now.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: I...can't think about the future.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Right. Yeah...
Sorry, I didn't mean to...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
We can talk about this later.
About us, and our future...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Thanks...
se_event_fire_2023_002

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Dammit...! Dammit, why...?!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Why...?

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Anyway, we're still going to become the best musicians in the world!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Why...?! Why Nagi...?!
Did it really have to be her...?!?!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Why Nagi...?!
